title: PRIMEAPE: A Multilingual Benchmark for Fine-Grained Meta-Evaluation of Judge Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.30925v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language models increasingly serve as judges of other models, shaping benchmark rankings and model development. Yet, a judge whose rationale consistently supports its verdict may still disagree with human preferences. To study this, we introduce PRIMEAPE, a multilingual benchmark for evaluating judge verdicts and rationales. PRIMEAPE provides 2,205 response pairs covering 243 instructions in English, French, Spanish, Urdu, Hindi, Norwegian Bokm{\aa}l, and Yoruba, with 11k human annotations of preferences and rationales across relevance, naturalness, truthfulness, safety, and overall quality. Our evaluation of twelve open- and closed-weight judges reveals that aggregate performance conceals differences across languages and criteria, while requesting rationales does not consistently improve agreement with human preferences. translated_title: PRIMEAPE：用于评判模型细粒度元评估的多语言基准
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型越来越多地充当其他模型的评判者，影响着基准测试排名和模型开发。然而，一个其理由始终支持其裁决的评判模型，仍可能与人类偏好不一致。为了研究这一问题，我们推出了 PRIMEAPE，一个用于评估评判模型裁决与理由的多语言基准。PRIMEAPE 提供了 2,205 个响应对，涵盖英语、法语、西班牙语、乌尔都语、印地语、挪威书面语（Bokmål）和约鲁巴语中的 243 条指令，并包含 11k 条涵盖相关性、自然性、真实性、安全性和整体质量的人类偏好与理由标注。我们对十二个开源与闭源权重评判模型的评估表明，总体性能掩盖了跨语言和跨评估标准的差异，而要求评判模型给出理由并不能持续提高其与人类偏好的一致性。评判模型还表现出对第一个位置、更长响应以及来自相关模型响应的偏好，其影响……
tldr: 提出了 PRIMEAPE 多语言基准，利用七种语言、2,205 个响应对和 11k 条人类标注对十二个评判模型的裁决与理由进行细粒度元评估，揭示总体性能掩盖了跨语言与跨标准的差异，并暴露出位置、长度和模型来源偏好等系统性偏见。
en_tdlr: PRIMEAPE is a multilingual benchmark with 2,205 response pairs and 11k human annotations across seven languages for fine-grained meta-evaluation of LLM judges, revealing that aggregate performance masks cross-lingual and cross-criterion differences and that judges exhibit position, length, and model-affinity biases.
